title.th: ประกาศห้างหุ้นส่วนจำกัด (คำสั่งตามมาตรา 17A(1)(d)) 2015
title.ms: Pemberitahuan Perkongsian Terhad (Arahan di bawah Seksyen 17A(1)(d)) 2015

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Limited Partnerships (Direction under section 17A(1)(d)) Notification 2015 and comes into operation on 3 January 2016.

2. The Minister directs that the Registrar must not accept for registration under the Act any name containing the word “Temasek” unless Temasek Holdings (Private) Limited (Registration No. 197401143C) is a general partner of the limited partnership.
3. The Limited Partnerships (Restriction on Registration of Name) Notification (N 1) is cancelled.
